Assignment Title: Fleet Telemetry Aggregator

Assignment Question:
A vehicle monitoring system uses multiple interfaces to aggregate status from two independent onboard modules: EngineStatus (tracking engine RPM) and TransmissionStatus (tracking active gear).
 
You are given a partially completed Java program. The driver code and interfaces are locked (Fixed Section), while the telemetry processing class contains bugs (Editable Section).
 
Your task is to debug the VehicleTelemetry class so that it properly implements both interfaces, correctly calculates the speed index, handles interface constants and boundary cases properly.
 
TOPIC COVERED:
- Multiple Interfaces
- Interface Constants & Variables
- Multiple Inheritance via Interfaces
- Method Resolution across Multiple Interfaces
 
INPUT FORMAT:
A single line containing two space-separated numbers:
1. rpm (double) - Engine RPM
2. gear (double) - Active gear
 
OUTPUT FORMAT:
Line 1: Combined Limit: [Max Limit]
Line 2: Telemetry Score: [Calculated Score rounded to 2 decimal places]
 
CONSTRAINTS:
- -2000.0 <= rpm <= 15000.0
- -5.0 <= gear <= 15.0
